headline: Türkiye Expands Share of Indian Destination Wedding Tourism Market
summary: Türkiye is increasing its share of the lucrative Indian wedding tourism market, driven by its luxury hotel capacity and international flight connectivity, according to industry representatives.
why: High-end destination tourism generates substantial foreign currency revenues and supports earnings for hospitality, aviation, and tourism services providers.

impacts.name: Turkish Tourism
impacts.why: Growth in luxury destination wedding bookings boosts hospitality revenues and service receipts.
